# Press Release


## TrustCo Declares Quarterly Dividend on the Heels of Strong Quarterly Results


Company Release - 11/18/2026 4:00 PM ET


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


GLENVILLE, N.Y., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of TrustCo Bank Corp NY (TrustCo, Nasdaq: TRST) on November 17, 2026 declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share, or $1.60 per share on an annualized basis. The dividend will be payable on January 4, 2027 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 4, 2026.


Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer Robert J. McCormick said: “Each November Trustco Bank celebrates its “Month of Thanks” to show appreciation to the Bank’s customers with specials and giveaways. We also are thankful that corporate performance continues to support our long-standing commitment to the payment of a meaningful dividend to our owners. We know that many of our owners depend upon our dividend as a foundational element of their financial affairs and are proud of this dependable payout.”


**About TrustCo Bank Corp NY**


TrustCo Bank Corp NY is a $6.5 billion savings and loan holding company and through its subsidiary, Trustco Bank, operated 133 offices in New York, New Jersey, Vermont, Massachusetts, and Florida as of October 31, 2026.


In addition, the Bank’s Wealth Management Department offers a full range of investment services, retirement planning and trust and estate administration services. The common shares of TrustCo are traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol TRST.
